quest.title: License to Glide
quest.description: Amber has specially prepared a gliding exam for you. She has also provided a gliding manual, which she has asked you to read before taking the exam.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x175, Mora x4375, Adventurer's Experience x2, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Gliding at Windrise is easy-peasy. Off you go!

talks.objective: Follow the route and fly to the finish line in time

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You nailed it! But it's no surprise, given the way you handle your glider in a storm.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: The next part of the exam is in Mondstadt. See you there, don't keep me waiting!

talks.objective: Follow Amber's instructions and take the exam again

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Cool. You'll make it this time, I just know it!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You gotta focus on your technique when you're gliding.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: If you wanna try again, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sure. But you gotta be 100% ready to glide.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Great, you're here! Did you have a good read-through of the gliding manual? Got all the rules down?

choices.text: I mean, I read it but...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Sounds like it was a real drag. I would know, I've been there...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The gliding manual is super dry... I couldn't get into it at all. Don't tell Jean though...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Hmm... Paimon thought there were some pretty cool stories in the gliding manual.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Cool stories? Oh, you must mean the example cases in the Appendix.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Some of them I like. My favorite one is about the illegal Anemo Slime take-off.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Apparently, if you pop an Anemo Slime and take off in the burst of wind, it shoots you up really, really high... I really wanna try it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, not that story. Paimon meant the one with the little bird who wanted to learn to fly.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Lemme take a look... Shoot, this is the storybook I used to read as a kid!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oops, sorry! I put both books in the same pile and must have grabbed the wrong one when I was leaving.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How in the heck do you confuse a bedtime story with an instruction manual?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It's because... Maybe deep down inside, that fairytale is the thing that truly taught me how to glide...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: "What you lacked was not wind. It's courage that's allowed you to become the first flying birds of this world."

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Reading that gave me the courage to glide, to become an Outrider, and to become the Gliding Champion of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...But anyway, let's get back to the exam!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Don't be nervous, just glide like you're used to.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Okay then. You just need to follow the <color=#00E1FFFF>marked route</color> to the finish.

choices.text: I can't say I really grasped the rules...
